_A_POPOVER_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: APopover shows a small window at a button with own content: text, links, fields and buttons. Unlike ATooltip the content is interactive, unlike AModal the page stays usable.
_A_POPOVER_ACCESSIBILITY_: Accessibility: a native button with aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded opens a non-modal role="dialog", named by the header or by the button. The focus goes to the first element of the content, Escape and the close button give it back to the button. In the container in body Tab after the last element goes to the element after the button. Inside AModal Escape closes only the popover. With hover the popover can be hovered and Escape closes it (WCAG 1.4.13).
_A_POPOVER_GROUP_BASIC_DESCRIPTION_: A button with a header and a text. A click outside, Escape and the close button close the popover.
_A_POPOVER_GROUP_FORM_DESCRIPTION_: The focus goes to the first field. The slots default, header and footer get close: it closes the popover and gives the focus back to the button.
_A_POPOVER_GROUP_ICON_DESCRIPTION_: A button with only an icon needs a name: button-text-screen-reader (without it the name is "Show details"). The icon is a name of AIconPlugin.
_A_POPOVER_GROUP_PLACEMENT_DESCRIPTION_: The popover changes the side when there is no space (flip) and stays in the window (shift). "auto" chooses the side with the most space.
_A_POPOVER_GROUP_HOVER_DESCRIPTION_: trigger="hover" opens the popover after open-delay and closes it after close-delay. The popover can be hovered, Escape closes it. The keyboard uses the button as before, a click keeps the popover open.
_A_POPOVER_GROUP_MODEL_DESCRIPTION_: With v-model the state is controlled from outside. open and close get the trigger: click, hover, close, escape, outside, focusout, api, model. The methods open, close and toggle work with a ref.
_A_POPOVER_EXAMPLE_TEXT_: Delivery takes 2–3 working days. Returns are free within 30 days.
_A_POPOVER_EXAMPLE_HELP_TEXT_: The tax number has 11 digits and is on your tax notice.
_A_POPOVER_EXAMPLE_HOVER_TEXT_: The popover stays open while the mouse is on the button or on the popover.
_A_POPOVER_PROPS_BUTTON_CLASS_DESCRIPTIO: Class of the button. The default can be set with AComponentsPlugin.
_A_POPOVER_PROPS_BUTTON_ICON_DESCRIPTION: Icon of the button: a name of AIconPlugin or an SVG.
_A_POPOVER_PROPS_BUTTON_TEXT_DESCRIPTION: Text of the button. Accepts a translation key.
_A_POPOVER_PROPS_BUTTON_TEXT_SCREEN_READ: Name of the button for the screen reader, e.g. for a button with only an icon.
_A_POPOVER_PROPS_CLOSE_DELAY_DESCRIPTION: trigger hover: delay in ms before closing.
_A_POPOVER_PROPS_CLOSE_ON_CLICK_OUTSIDE_: A click outside closes the popover.
_A_POPOVER_PROPS_CLOSE_ON_FOCUS_OUT_DESC: The popover closes when the focus leaves the button and the popover.
_A_POPOVER_PROPS_FOCUS_ON_OPEN_DESCRIPTI: Focus after opening: first (the first element of the content), popover (the popover) or none. Opening by hover does not move the focus.
_A_POPOVER_PROPS_HAS_ARROW_DESCRIPTION_: Shows the arrow to the button.
_A_POPOVER_PROPS_HAS_CLOSE_BUTTON_DESCRI: Shows the close button in the header.
_A_POPOVER_PROPS_HEADER_DESCRIPTION_: Header of the popover, also the name of the dialog. Accepts a translation key.
_A_POPOVER_PROPS_HEADER_TAG_DESCRIPTION_: Tag of the header, e.g. h2 for a heading of the page structure.
_A_POPOVER_PROPS_IN_BODY_DESCRIPTION_: The popover is in a container in body, so a parent with overflow: hidden does not cut it.
_A_POPOVER_PROPS_MODEL_VALUE_DESCRIPTION: Open state for v-model. Without it the popover has its own state.
_A_POPOVER_PROPS_OFFSET_DESCRIPTION_: Distance to the button in px.
_A_POPOVER_PROPS_OPEN_DELAY_DESCRIPTION_: trigger hover: delay in ms before opening.
_A_POPOVER_PROPS_PLACEMENT_DESCRIPTION_: Side of the popover: top, right, bottom, left (with -start / -end) or auto.
_A_POPOVER_PROPS_POPPER_CONTAINER_ID_DES: Id of the container in body for in-body.
_A_POPOVER_PROPS_TRIGGER_DESCRIPTION_: click (default) or hover. With hover the keyboard still uses the button.
_A_POPOVER_SLOTS_DEFAULT_DESCRIPTION_: Content of the popover. Props: { close }.
_A_POPOVER_SLOTS_FOOTER_DESCRIPTION_: Footer, e.g. buttons. Props: { close }.
_A_POPOVER_SLOTS_HEADER_DESCRIPTION_: Own header instead of the prop header, also the name of the dialog. Props: { close }.
_A_POPOVER_PROPS_IS_BOTTOM_SHEET_ON_MOBI: On a small screen (AMobilePlugin) the popover is a panel at the bottom of the window with a backdrop, without the arrow.
_A_POPOVER_PROPS_Z_INDEX_DESCRIPTION_: Stack order. Without it the token --a_popover_z_index: above modals, so a popover in AModal is visible. Set a smaller value if the popover must stay under own fixed layers.
_A_POPOVER_SLOTS_TRIGGER_DESCRIPTION_: Own element instead of the button. Bind attributes to it (id, ARIA, events). Props: { attributes, isOpen, close }.
_A_POPOVER_GROUP_TRIGGER_DESCRIPTION_: The slot trigger replaces the button, e.g. with an own AButton. v-bind="attributes" gives it the id, the ARIA attributes and the events. Use a button: it is focusable and works with Enter and Space.
_A_POPOVER_GROUP_NESTED_DESCRIPTION_: A popover in a popover: the focus and the clicks in the inner one keep the outer one open, Escape closes the inner one first, a click in the outer one closes only the inner one.
_A_POPOVER_ACCESSIBILITY_MOBILE_: On a small screen the popover is a modal bottom sheet: aria-modal="true", Tab and Shift+Tab stay in the sheet, the rest of the page is inert. An own trigger in the slot trigger that is no button gets role="button", tabindex="0", Enter and Space and a warning in the console; a link with href gets only the warning.
